p: These documents may be out of date.

This is all the offical server documentation and information for Springfield Roleplay. Please use the selections on the side to select the different documents. If you have any questions please don't hesitate to open a ticket.

l: I'm staff, where is the staff information?
p: To find staff information please follow the instructions given in the staff information channels or open a ticket. Staff information will not be displayed here.
Below you will find our Discord Community Guidelines. Please be sure to read them carefully to avoid punishments, if you have any questions please open a ticket via our Discord server.
Respect. Whilst in SRP you must remain respectful at all times. Treat others how you want to be treated.
Swearing. Swearing is not permitted at SRP. Swearing will result in a ban.
Spam. Spamming of any kind will result in a timeout. This includes links, images, text.
NSFW Material. Sending any NSFW material will result in an instant ban.
Threats. Threatening anyone for any reason will result in punishment.
Racial Slurs. Using any racial slurs will result in an instant ban.
Discord Guidelines. You must follow all Discord Guidelines at all time. https://discord.com/guidelines
We reserve the right to moderate you at anytime we deem it necessary, while in Springfield Roleplay you accept these rules and accept the fact you may be moderated at anytime.
Below you will find our in-game guidelines. Please be sure to read them carefully to avoid punishments, if you have any questions please open a ticket.
RDM. Random death match, this is killing someone without being in RP.
VDM. Vehicle death match, this is someone damaging your vehicle while not in RP.
NLR. New life rule, once you die in-game you must forget all info in your last RP, you cannot return to scene after death.
FRP. Fail roleplay, when a user fails to roleplay or breaks the current roleplay.
LTAP. Leave to avoid punishment, leaving the game to avoid being moderated by staff.
Cuff Rush & Auto Jail. The act of cuffing a user without saying -cuffs- before cuffing. After cuffing you must transport the user to the prison then jail them.
Disrespect. You must respect all other players and staff.
Safe Zones. Shootings/killing in safe zones will result in punishment. Safe zones include: All spawn points.
Unrealistic Avatars. Your avatar must be realistic, unrealistic avatars include: Headless, large accessories, animal RP.
Roblox ToS. You must follow Roblox's terms of service at all times. https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us/articles/203313410-Roblox-Community-Standards
We reserve the right to moderate you at anytime we deem it necessary, while in the in-game Springfield Roleplay server you accept these rules and accept the fact you may be moderated at anytime.
